title: Overnight in Socorro
body: First night on the road — Best Western in Socorro, NM, after a long desert drive east.

title: Garden of the Gods
body: Colorado Springs for a couple of nights. Jeep tour up toward the waterfall country on the 2nd — red rock, thin air, and a full day outside.

title: OKC overnight
body: Wyndham Grand downtown in Oklahoma City — a pause between the Springs and the long Texas stay.

title: Courtyard stretch
body: Checked into the Courtyard in San Angelo for a long stay. Most of April lived here — mornings on familiar streets, weekends mixed in.

title: North for a week
body: Flew San Angelo to DFW to Fargo. Courtyard in town, a Budget car for getting around, and evenings for Crafts and Drafts and whatever the neighborhood was serving.

title: South again
body: Turned south. Hotel Paso Del Norte in El Paso for the night — Polarsteps still ticking toward the New Mexico border through the 27th.
